sections.title: Module 1: Podocyte Biology, Slit Diaphragm Architecture, and Pathophysiology of Proteinuria
sections.content:
### 1. Podocyte Molecular Architecture & Glomerular Filtration Barrier

Glomerular Filtration Barrier 由 Capillary Endothelium、GBM 與 Podocyte Foot Processes 三層結構共同組成。Podocyte 為高度特化之 Terminal Differentiated Epithelial Cells，其 Foot Processes 彼此交錯形成 Slit Diaphragm [權威文獻對照: Brenner 11e Ch 4 Fig. 4.2, Ch 30 Fig. 30.1]。

#### Slit Diaphragm Key Molecular Components:
- **NPHS1**: Transmembrane cell adhesion protein，雙分子交聯構成 Filtration Slit 之主要 Meshwork。缺陷導致 Congenital Nephrotic Syndrome of the Finnish Type。
- **NPHS2**: Hairpin-like membrane protein，錨定 Nephrin 至 Podocyte Cytoskeleton。缺陷導致 Steroid-SRNS。
- **CD2AP** & **α-Actinin-ACTN4**: 連接 Slit Diaphragm 與 Actin Cytoskeleton。

### 2. Pathophysiology of Nephrotic Syndrome Manifestations

Nephrotic Syndrome 之三大核心生理轉變包含 Massive Proteinuria (> 3.5 g/24h)、Hypoalbuminemia (< 3.0 g/dL) 與 Peripheral Edema [權威文獻對照: Brenner 11e Ch 30 Fig. 30.11, Fig. 30.12]。

#### Topology Mapping Matrix: Microstructural Injury to Systemic Features
| Target Structure / Injury | Pathophysiological Cascade | Systemic Clinical Manifestation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Slit Diaphragm Disruption & Foot Process Effacement | Loss of size-selective barrier & Negative charge reduction | Heavy Proteinuria (> 3.5 g/24h) |
| Severe Urinary Albumin Loss | Hepatic albumin synthesis capacity exceeded | Hypoalbuminemia (< 3.0 g/dL) |
| Decreased Plasma Oncotic Pressure |Underfill mechanism | Peripheral & Facial Edema |
| Hepatic Compensatory Lipoprotein Synthesis | Increased ApoB-100 & Decreased LPL Activity | Hyperlipidemia &Oval Fat Bodies |
| Loss of Antithrombin III & Plasminogen | Elevated Factor V, VIII, Fibrinogen & Platelet hyperaggregability | Hypercoagulability & Renal Vein Thrombosis |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree: Edema Mechanisms

```
Nephrotic Syndrome State
  ├─Primary Alteration [Brenner 11e Ch 30 Fig. 30.11]
  │    └─ Hypoalbuminemia -> Decreased Plasma Oncotic Pressure -> Interstitial Extravasation -> Intravascular Depletion -> RAAS Activation & ADH Release -> Sodium & Water Retention
  └─Primary Tubular Alteration [Brenner 11e Ch 30 Fig. 30.12]
       └─ENaC Activation via Protease Cleavage -> Intravascular Expansion -> Suppression of RAAS -> Hypertension & Edema
```

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!WARNING]
> **Conceptual Trap 1**: 不可將所有 Nephrotic Edema 皆歸因於 Underfill Mechanism。在 Minimal Change Disease 常見 Underfill，但在 Adult Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis 及 Membranous Nephropathy 中，ENaC activation via urinary plasmin proteolytic cleavage。
> 
> **Conceptual Trap 2**: Prophylactic Anticoagulation 需評估 Serum Albumin 數值。Membranous Nephropathy 患者當 Serum Albumin < 2.2 g/dL 且伴有 High VTE Risk 時，應積極給予 Full-dose Anticoagulation 。

sections.title: Module 2: Primary Glomerular Diseases (MCD, FSGS, MN, MPGN)
sections.content:
### 1. Primary Glomerulopathies Overview

Primary Glomerular Diseases 為引發 Adult 與 Pediatric Nephrotic Syndrome 之首要病因。區分各自的 Histopathology、EMIF 呈現為核心檢定考點 [權威文獻對照: Brenner 11e Ch 31 Fig. 31.4, 31.5, 31.7, 31.11]。

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Feature / Disease |MCD |FSGS |MN |MPGN |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Peak Incidence** | Children (80%), Adults (10-15%) | Adults & Children | Adults > 40 years | Young Adults & Children |
| **Light Microscopy** | Normal Glomeruli, Lipid in Tubules | Focal & Segmental Sclerosis / Hyalinosis | Thickened Capillary Loops, GBM Spikes | Tram-Double Contours, Lobular Accentuation |
| **Immunofluorescence** | Negative | IgM & C3 in Segmental Sclerotic lesions | Granular IgG & C3 along Capillary Walls | Granular C3, IgG,Immune-complex pattern |
| **Electron Microscopy** | Diffuse Podocyte Foot Process Effacement [Brenner 11e Ch 31 Fig. 31.4] | Foot Process Effacement (Diffuse in Primary, Segmental in Secondary) | Subepithelial Electron-dense Deposits [Brenner 11e Ch 31 Fig. 31.7] |Type IDDD |
| **Serologic Markers** | None |African Ancestry | Anti-PLA2R (70-80%), Anti-THSD7A, Anti-NELL1 | Low Complement (C3, C4 in Immune-complex; Low C3 only in C3G) |

### 3. Histologic Variants of FSGS & Prognostic Significance [Brenner 11e Ch 31 Fig. 31.5]
- **Perihilar Variant**:Hyperfiltration due to reduced nephron mass or obesity.
- **Tip Lesion Variant**: Prognosis最佳，對 Steroids 反應良好.
- **Collapsing Variant**: 最具侵襲性，Glomerular Tuft Collapse & Podocyte Hyperplasia. 常見於 HIV, COVID-19, APOL1 High-risk Genotypes, Pamidronate use.
- **Cellular Variant**: Endocapillary Hypercellularity filling Capillary Lumens.
- **Not Otherwise Specified**: 最常見之傳統 FSGS 類型.

### 4. Membranous Nephropathy Ultrastructural Stages [Brenner 11e Ch 31 Fig. 31.7]
- **Stage I**: Small Subepithelial Deposits, Normal GBM on Light Microscopy.
- **Stage II**:PAM stain positive.
- **Stage III**:Dome-and-Spike pattern.
- **Stage IV**:Moth-eaten appearance.

### 5. MPGN vs C3 Glomerulopathy Classification [Brenner 11e Ch 31 Fig. 31.11]
- **Immune-Complex Mediated MPGN**: Immunoglobulin positive (IgG/IgM/IgA + Complement), 驅動自 Chronic Infections, Autoimmune Diseases 或 Monoclonal Gammopathy.
- **Complement-Mediated MPGN / C3 Glomerulopathy**: Immunoglobulin negative (C3-dominant with C3 intensity ≥ 2 orders of magnitude over Ig), 由 Alternative Complement Pathway Dysregulation 驅動.

### 6. Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!WARNING]
> **Conceptual Trap 1**: 勿因 Subepithelial Deposits 即判定為 Lupus Class V。Secondary Membranous Nephropathy 需主動排除 Solid Organ Malignancy (Prostate, Lung, Colon, Breast), Hepatitis B Virus, Syphilis, NSAIDs, Penicillamine。
> 
> **Conceptual Trap 2**: MPGN 於 2021 KDIGO 已重分類為 **Immune-Complex Mediated MPGN** (Ig positive, Immunoglobulins + Complement) 與 **Complement-Mediated MPGN / C3 Glomerulopathy** (Ig negative, C3 only). 勿再使用舊版 Type I / II / III 混淆診斷 [Brenner 11e Ch 31 Fig. 31.11]。

sections.title: Module 3: Secondary Glomerular Diseases & Systemic Etiologies
sections.content:
### 1. Secondary Glomerular Involvement Spectrum

Secondary Nephrotic Syndrome 由 Systemic Diseases, Metabolic Disorders, Autoimmune Diseases, Infections 或 Malignancy 引起。精準判讀 Renal Biopsy 特徵與全身特徵為重要解題樞紐 [權威文獻對照: Brenner 11e Ch 39 Fig. 39.6, Ch 32 Fig. 32.24, Fig. 32.25]。

### 2. High-Yield Secondary Etiologies Differential Matrix

| Secondary Etiology | Key Histopathological Finding | Immunofluorescence Pattern | Key Diagnostic / Serologic Marker |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DKD** | Kimmelstiel-Wilson Nodules, Nodular Glomerulosclerosis, Capsular Drop [Brenner 11e Ch 39 Fig. 39.6] |Non-immune trapping | Long-standing Diabetes, Retinopathy, Microalbuminuria progression |
| **AL / AA** | Amorphous Acellular Deposits in Mesangium & Vessels; Congo Red Positive [Brenner 11e Ch 32 Fig. 32.24] | Monoclonal Light Chain (κ or λ) in AL; Negative in AA | Apple-Green Birefringence under Polarized Light [Brenner 11e Ch 32 Fig. 32.25]; Serum Free Light Chains |
| **Membranous** | Diffuse Subepithelial Deposits with Thickened GBM | Full-House Pattern (IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q Positive) | ANA, Anti-dsDNA, Low Complement C3/C4, Anti-Sm |
| **HBV Associated GN** | Membranous Nephropathy or MPGN Pattern | Granular HBeAg / HBsAg deposits | HBV Serology (HBsAg+, HBeAg+, High HBV DNA) |
| **HCV Associated GN** | MPGN Pattern with Type II Mixed Cryoglobulinemia | Granular IgG, IgM, C3 with Intracapillary Thrombi | HCV RNA+, Positive Rheumatoid Factor, Cryoglobulins |
| **Syphilis Associated GN** | Membranous Nephropathy with Subepithelial Deposits | Granular IgG & C3 | Positive VDRL/RPR, TPHA/TPPA,Palmar Papules |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree: Amyloidosis Classification

```
Glomerular Amorphous Deposits Suspected
  ├─ Congo Red Stain Positive [Brenner 11e Ch 32 Fig. 32.25]
  │    ├─ Polarized Light Inspection -> Apple-Green Birefringence Confirmed
  │    ├─ AL Amyloidosis Subtype -> Monoclonal Plasma Cell Dyscrasia (Serum/Urine Immunofixation, SPEP/UPEP, SPEP Free Light Chain Ratio)
  │    └─ AA Amyloidosis Subtype -> Chronic Inflammatory Condition (Rheumatoid Arthritis, Osteomyelitis, FMF, Bronchiectasis)
  └─ Congo Red Stain Negative
       └─ Consider Fibrillary Glomerulonephritis (DNAJB9 Positive, 16-24 nm Fibrils) or Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (Microtubules > 30 nm)
```

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!WARNING]
> **Conceptual Trap 1**:Kimmelstiel-Wilson 需與 Amyloidosis, MPGN,LCDD 鑑別 [Brenner 11e Ch 39 Fig. 39.6 vs Ch 32 Fig. 32.24]。Amyloidosis 為 Congo Red 陽性；LCDD 為 Monoclonal κ/λ 染色；DKD 則伴隨 Retinopathy, Arteriosclerosis 與 Thickened Capillary Loops。
> 
> **Conceptual Trap 2**: Secondary Syphilitic Nephropathy 在年輕男性表現為 Nephrotic Syndrome Palmar Skin Rash。其 Pathology 多為 Membranous Nephropathy。Podocyte Foot Process Effacement 亦極顯著，不可誤診為 Minimal Change Disease。

sections.title: Module 4: Treatment Strategies and KDIGO Guidelines
sections.content:
### 1. Management Principles of Nephrotic Syndrome

Nephrotic Syndrome 之治療包含 Supportive Care 與 Disease-Specific Immunosuppressive Therapy。Anti-PLA2R Titer, Histology 與 Risk Stratification 制定精準治療藍圖 [權威文獻對照: Brenner 11e Ch 33 Fig. 33.1 / KDIGO 2021 Guidelines Fig. 1]。

### 2. KDIGO Risk Stratification & Immunosuppression Guidelines

####MCD:
- **First-line Therapy**: High-dose Oral Corticosteroids (Prednisone 1 mg/kg/day, max 80 mg/day, for 4-16 weeks).
- **Relapsing / Steroid-Dependent MCD**: Cyclophosphamide,Tacrolimus / Cyclosporine, or Rituximab.

####FSGS:
- **First-line Therapy**: High-dose Corticosteroids for at least 8-16 weeks.
- **Steroid-Resistant FSGS**: Calcineurin Inhibitors (CNIs, Tacrolimus / Cyclosporine) for at least 6 months.

####MN:
- **Low Risk** (Normal eGFR, Proteinuria < 3.5 g/day, Anti-PLA2R Low): Wait-and-see with maximum ACEi/ARB for 6 months.
- **Moderate Risk** (Proteinuria 3.5-8 g/day, Normal eGFR, Anti-PLA2R Moderate): Rituximab OR CNI + Low-dose Steroids.
- **High Risk** (Proteinuria > 8 g/day or eGFR decline, Anti-PLA2R High > 50 RU/mL): Rituximab OR Cyclophosphamide +Modified Ponticelli Regimen OR CNI + Rituximab.
- **Very High Risk** (Rapidly declining eGFR, Severe Nephrotic Syndrome): Cyclophosphamide + High-dose Steroids.

### 3. Supportive Management Guidelines Matrix

| Supportive Intervention | Clinical Target | Guideline Recommendation & Mechanism |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Renin-Angiotensin System Blockade** | Proteinuria & Intrarenal Pressure | ACEi or ARB titrated to maximum tolerated dose; Reduce intraglomerular hyperfiltration |
| **Prophylactic Anticoagulation** |VTE | Indicated in Membranous Nephropathy with Serum Albumin < 2.0-2.5 g/dL & High VTE Risk; Aspirin for Arterial Risk |
| **Lipid Management** | Hyperlipidemia & Cardiovascular Risk | HMG-Statin for persistent nephrotic hypercholesterolemia |
| **Edema Management** | Fluid Overload & Anasarca | Dietary Sodium Restriction (< 2 g/day);Furosemide / Bumetanide +/- Thiazide or ENaC Blocker |
| **Infection Prophylaxis** | Encapsulated Bacterial Infections |PCV20 / PPSV23; Annual Influenza Vaccine |

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis
> [!WARNING]
> **Conceptual Trap 1**: 在 Membranous Nephropathy 中，Anti-PLA2R Antibody Titer 下降快於 Proteinuria Immunologic Remission leads Clinical Remission by 3-6 months。切勿在 Anti-PLA2R 已轉陰性但 Proteinuria 尚未完全消除時盲目加重 Immunosuppressants。
> 
> **Conceptual Trap 2**: Secondary FSGS (如 Obesity-related, Reflux-related, reduced nephron mass) **禁止給予 High-dose Corticosteroids 或 Immunosuppressive Therapy**！應使用 Maximum RAS Blockade, SGLT2 Inhibitors 與 Weight Management 減緩 Hyperfiltration。
